title: [Extensibility Request] issue 29074: expose PurchLineQty in OnSumPurchLines2OnBeforeDivideAmount
summary: The OnSumPurchLines2OnBeforeDivideAmount event now exposes the PurchLineQty parameter by reference, allowing subscribers to adjust the purchase line quantity before amount division calculations run.
key_points: Added var PurchLineQty parameter to OnSumPurchLines2OnBeforeDivideAmount event signature
Enables extensions to modify quantity before DivideAmount logic executes
Change propagated across all country-specific layers (APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, GB, IT, NA, RU, W1)
Supports specialized purchasing modes like amount-only processing
Event fires at the right point in SumPurchLines2 function
